cache_pools.description: Cache pjproject memory pools for performance. Set to 'no' for debugging with valgrind.

log_level.description: Initial maximum pjproject logging level to log. Valid values are: 0-6, and default.

asterisk_error.description: A comma separated list of pjproject log levels to map to Asterisk errors.

asterisk_warning.description: A comma separated list of pjproject log levels to map to Asterisk warnings.

asterisk_notice.description: A comma separated list of pjproject log levels to map to Asterisk notices.

asterisk_verbose.description: A comma separated list of pjproject log levels to map to Asterisk verbose.

asterisk_debug.description: A comma separated list of pjproject log levels to map to Asterisk debug.

asterisk_trace.description: A comma separated list of pjproject log levels to map to Asterisk trace.
